message.content:
When you toss three fair coins, the number of heads you can obtain is any integer from 0 to 3.  
In other words, the possible outcomes are:

| Heads | Probability |
|-------|-------------|
| 0     | 1/8 (12.5 %) |
| 1     | 3/8 (37.5 %) |
| 2     | 3/8 (37.5 %) |
| 3     | 1/8 (12.5 %) |

So you can get **0, 1, 2, or 3 heads**.
